paper_metadata.title: On-Die Termination Resistors With Analog Impedance Control for Standard CMOS Technology
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, we have designed a new voltage-controlled resistor for the purpose of on-die termination in standard CMOS technology. Current–voltage ( – ) characteristics show that this on-die termination resistor has good linearity across a wide range of gate bias, and is suitable for analog impedance control technique using a feedback loop. The analog impedance control technique has the advantage of continuous impedance adjustment without interfering with normal data transmission and receiving operations. Experimental – characteristics show excellent linearity and are in good agreement with simulations. Measured resistance values are within 5% over process, temperature, and across die variations.
